signature: A fog-bound valley that will not stay the same place: a dawn rainforest where you weigh almost nothing, then - after the little lights circle you and the ground lurches - a luminous arctic of glaciers and frozen river under Light Guides, with the way to Level 46 never where it was.

exits.label: Climbed the sand-covered tree (rainforest) / stood on the sand-covered ice sheet (arctic) and came out in Level 46
exits.method: Rainforest state: climb a sand-covered tree; arctic state: stand on a sand-covered ice sheet
exits.source_quote: The location of the exit is different with each alteration, but the destination is constant.
exits.hint: Something here is the colour of a beach. It moves every time the land does.

fail_states.label: Encased by a glacier rising under you during an alteration
fail_states.source_quote: you can become encased within the changing terrain

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Light Guides (arctic state, CONFIRMED by name only) shown as groups of small drifting lights, never interactive. Rainforest state: no entity per source (native organisms implied only by insect ambience).
notes: SOURCE: terminal frame with two backup files; File 1: heavy rainforest, persistent fog, gravity greatly reduced for foreign objects/entities only, permanent dawn, constant 21 C, base theoretically possible; exit: climb a tree covered in sand (Level 46). File 2 (current state): arctic, luminous highly reflective ice, ~13 h day-night, 10-6 C, large groups of Light Guides; terrain alters at unknown intervals and its properties change; no long-term bases; testimony: glaciers jutting up, rivers gushing from boulders, freezing air, small orbs as a warning, encasement (frostbite and scrapes); the Level Key changed with the level; exit location changes with each alteration, destination constant: stand on a sheet of ice covered in sand; 'Walked into a rainforest, walked out of a tundra.' ADAPTATION: one valley ~260 m across with ridges, a mesa with a walkable spur and a river; both states share it; the alteration is a front sweeping out from a seeded point 70 m from you (trees sink, glaciers rise, the river freezes or thaws); seeded starting state; intervals 4-7 min with a 25 s orb warning (never in QA); the arctic day is compressed to 13 minutes; low gravity (3.4 m/s2) applies to the player only in the rainforest; Light Guides' look is not in the snapshot (drifting lights); the climb of the sand tree is an interact at its base; the ice-sheet exit is a 2.5 s dwell; the clipboard printouts paraphrase the two files; a soft push-back stops you climbing the ridges past r=132 m. QA: the first exit spot is 30-40 m from the arrival on dry ground.
